items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: I played with Rabbit a couple of times, but Rabbit played so bad I had to let him go.

ctx.x: That passed just two blocks, one block across James Allen. That's where Rabbit used to hang out. That's right. I know Rabbit. That's right. I played with Rabbit a couple of times, but Rabbit played so bad I had to let him go.

items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1960-09-28
items.q: Yeah, he used to come in there and sing all those numbers he made up.

ctx.x: Here's some more. Where did Rabbit sing Downfall of the Lion?

Yeah, the Tom Anderson Cabaret. He hung around there, huh? Yeah, he used to come in there and sing all those numbers he made up. And he made up another song about Gypsy Blood, the time they had all that killing down there. He had several little songs right there.
You mean Billy Phillips and that Parker fella that got killed?
